1. Adds IPv6 router advertisement acceptance setting to sysctl.conf
2. Enables IPv6 forwarding temporarily

**Important Security Note**: This should only be executed on systems you own or have explicit authorization to modify, as it affects network security settings.

To execute this safely:

```bash

sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_ra
sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding

# Verify changes
sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_ra
sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding
```

The safer approach is to use `sudo` explicitly rather than running as root directly. The changes will:
